injuryBoundaryReview.limitation: Literal printed NFL play injury annotations and injury/return updates are retained. An update without a complete printed exit-to-return interval remains UNRESOLVED and is not converted into a full-game or partial-game numerical loss.

specialistReview.safeguard: Special-teams-only participation does not establish a defensive replacement effect.

blockers.finding: Sean Rhyan and Jordan Monk are first printed as Questionable without an initial injury play; Rhyan is later Out. Devonte Wyatt has a return but no printed initial injury play, and Ennis Rakestraw has a Questionable notice without a return. Matthew Golden has a complete injury-to-return interval.
blockers.footballImpact: Only complete intervals may enter exposure arithmetic; inventing the missing entry or return clocks could overstate or understate line and secondary losses.
blockers.nextAction: Use the complete Golden interval. For Rhyan, Monk, Wyatt and Rakestraw, use an already approved bounded method only if its conditions are satisfied; otherwise retain the unknown boundary.

blockers.finding: The paired official gamebook inventory is complete. Tutu Atwell is closed active and Trent McDuffie is resolved through the approved Josh Wallace primary-replacement case. Carter Runyon and Chris Collier remain reserve identities absent from the locked registry/supplement.
blockers.footballImpact: Runyon and Collier cannot receive a numerical baseline until identity, roster duty and value provenance are governed.
blockers.nextAction: For Runyon and Collier, bind an official/independent identity and approved value source or record a supported no-established-baseline-role ruling.

blockers.finding: Ian Thomas and Patrick Johnson are first printed as Questionable without a printed initial injury play, though both later return. Kamren Curl, Colby Parkinson and J.J. Watson have printed injury-to-return sequences.
blockers.footballImpact: Only the complete intervals can be exposure-weighted without guessing; unknown entry clocks could distort the Raiders' tight-end and edge-rotation loss.
blockers.nextAction: Use the complete Curl, Parkinson and Watson intervals. Apply the approved brief-return prior to Thomas or Johnson only if the literal-source conditions hold; otherwise preserve the missing entry boundary.

blockers.finding: Trent McDuffie is resolved at a 1.7-point loss with Josh Wallace as the distinct zero-point primary replacement. Carter Runyon and Chris Collier still lack locked/supplement identities and governed roster-role values; missing values are not zero.
blockers.footballImpact: The remaining cases affect whether any reserve baseline belongs in Las Vegas' healthy side.
blockers.nextAction: Resolve Runyon and Collier through the approved value hierarchy and source-confirmed role assessment, without inferring defensive duty from special teams alone.
